description: What a specific mortgage lender did in a year — applications, originations, denials and dollar volume — from the federal Home Mortgage Disclosure Act register, optionally narrowed to a state or county. Identify the lender by its LEI (the 20-character Legal Entity Identifier HMDA files under); resolve_entity maps a company name to one. Covers every US mortgage application 2018-2025. Reports what lenders DISCLOSED, which is a regulatory filing rather than a market estimate.

county.description: Optional 5-digit county FIPS, e.g. "06037" for Los Angeles.

year.description: Filing year, 2018-2025. Defaults to the most recent published.

name: hmda_lender_activity
title: Hmda Lender Activity
